claim: Compared Olink Explore 3072 in UK Biobank with SomaScan v4 in Iceland; 1,514 Icelanders were measured on both.

claim: Modest cross-platform correlation: median Spearman 0.33 across 1,848 proteins in the 1,514 Icelanders measured on both.

claim: Showed the potential of MS-based proteomics for pQTL discovery in non-European ancestries: over 1,200 locus-protein associations, more than half not previously reported.

About one-third of the protein groups detected were not captured by the affinity platforms. Protein-altering variants mapped to 38.8% of MS cis-pQTLs, and peptide-level evidence helped clarify genetic mechanisms.
Multiple platforms are needed to capture the full spectrum of pQTLs. Most disagreement between platforms was technical (54 to 67% explained by technical factors).
